text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Pheee～w! Bakushin on a day off is truly 
something special! I seem to have come all 
the way to the prefecture border without 
noticing…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmhm!? Running over there, my rival――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's the Shinkansen…! As expected, what a 
magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…But I'm no slouch either! Allow me to 
show to you the fruits of my training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hah… Haaaah… I never thought I'd… lose 
sight of it… A, and――

By the time she got back to Tracen 
Academy, even Sakura Bakushin O was 
exhausted…
